order.title: MAJOR ORDER
order.briefing: Defend the designated planets, wielding the TD-110 Maelstrom Tank to support a public awareness sales campaign.

dispatch.message: MAJOR ORDER WON Buoyed by inspiring footage of the Federation's greatest heroes decimating its greatest enemies, Maelstrom Tank sales to the public have skyrocketed. Citizens are clamoring for the opportunity to defend their homes and families with their very own Tank. The Maelstrom Tank is available for Helldiver use in perpetuity.

opening.message: NEW MAJOR ORDER Unrelenting enemy aggression has put production of the Maelstrom Tank in jeopardy. To recoup costs, the Helldivers are ordered to aid the creation of a public awareness sales campaign. Footage of the Helldivers obliterating Freedom's enemies could increase pre-sales, providing the funding needed to save the project. GATRIA and WASAT have just come under attack. Deploy to defend these planets, utilizing the Maelstrom Tank.
